description: The owner's own space, which only they can read. Each account has one, with the space key self.

main.description: The owner's own space, which only they can read. Each account has one, at at://{owner DID}/space/app.logdate.space.personal/self. Every record in it is an app.logdate.crypto.sealed envelope, so the server can't tell what kind of record it holds.
main.name: Your LogDate journal
